summary.short: São Paulo State decree granting ICMS suspension, deferral and exemption on listed servers, switches and rack equipment acquired for fixed assets by companies whose main activity is CNAE 6311-9/00 (data processing, application hosting). Requires a special regime request; conditions include employment, regional and environmental criteria. Effective 1 January 2021.
summary.long: The decree sets ICMS treatment for listed data-center equipment acquired for fixed assets by companies whose main economic activity is CNAE 6311-9/00 (data processing, application service providers and internet hosting). Covered items are rack-mounted servers with storage, ASIC and hypervisor features, and switches with at least 128 10/40/100 Gbps ports, classified under NCM 8471.49.00 and 8517.62.39. Imports are suspended and domestic sales deferred, with other operations exempt (Art. 1). Suspension applies only to equipment used exclusively in the importer's production process, and the suspended or deferred tax is paid with the recipient's later sale (Art. 1 §§ 2-3). Eligibility requires at least one of six conditions, including job creation, a non-existent activity, local inputs, strategic status, a priority region or logistics infrastructure (Art. 2). Simples Nacional firms and communication services are excluded; the regime is conditioned on use of state port or airport infrastructure, customs clearance in São Paulo, expansion or revitalization projects, and environmental compliance (Art. 3). Firms must request a special regime, which is automatically revoked for non-compliance, unapproved design changes, environmental harm, tax crimes, definitive shutdown or economic-order offences (Art. 4). Takes effect 1 January 2021 (Art. 5).

The cover letter also states that tax matters fall within its competence.

Inconsistency: the cover letter (Ofício GS-CAT) describes the measure as isenção e diferimento, but Art. 1, I also provides suspensão of ICMS on imports; the decree text governs. Art. 3, II, III refers to unnamed competent environmental bodies, not coded as entities. Technical specifications in Art. 1, § 1º (e.g., 128 switches, 10/40/100 Gbps) are not coded here. Relations and entities both have entries, so their section_status entries are placeholders required by the schema.

obligations.summary: Suspension of ICMS on imports of the listed equipment is admitted only where the equipment is used exclusively in the importing company's production process. Applies to companies registered under CNAE 6311-9/00.
obligations.conditional_on: Equipment listed in Art. 1 § 1; company with CNAE 6311-9/00 as principal activity

evidence.quote: A suspensão na forma do inciso I somente será admitida em relação aos equipamentos relacionados no § 1º utilizados exclusivamente no processo produtivo da empresa importadora.

obligations.summary: ICMS suspended or deferred under Art. 1 I and II must be paid cumulatively with the tax due on the recipient company's sale, with the sale value as the tax base.
obligations.conditional_on: Suspension or deferral under Art. 1, incisos I and II

evidence.quote: O imposto suspenso ou diferido na forma dos incisos I e II será pago cumulativamente com o devido pela saída realizada pela empresa destinatária

obligations.summary: Companies may benefit only if they meet at least one of six conditions: job creation; non-existing economic activity or product without similar in the State; predominant use of State inputs; strategic status; location in a priority region; or boosting existing logistics infrastructure.
obligations.conditional_on: At least one of the conditions in Art. 2 items I to VI

evidence.quote: Podem beneficiar-se do disposto neste decreto as empresas que atendam, pelo menos, a uma das seguintes condições

obligations.summary: Benefit is conditional on: preferential use of State port and airport infrastructure; import clearance in the State; for expansion projects, expansion or diversification of productive capacity; for revitalization projects, a stoppage of at least 12 months before the special-regime application; and regular standing with competent environmental bodies where applicable (Art. 3 II and III). Art. 3, Parágrafo único clarifies that simple replacement or refurbishment is not an expansion.
obligations.conditional_on: Conditions listed in Art. 3 II a) to d) and III, as applicable

enforcement.authority: Not stated in the text; revocation is described as automatic
enforcement.triggered_by: Art. 4º, parágrafo único, items 1-6: (1) non-compliance with the conditions fixed in the special regime; (2) project change without communication and approval by the Secretaria da Fazenda e Planejamento; (3) conduct or activity harmful to the environment; (4) crimes against the tax order or tax evasion; (5) definitive cessation of activities; (6) conduct or activity harmful to the economic order
enforcement.max_penalty_text: No monetary penalty stated; the consequence is automatic revocation (cassação) of the special regime

evidence.quote: O regime especial será automaticamente cassado nas seguintes hipóteses
